however, the respondent no.2 is serving in Armed Force, and as such is most of the time on the move, as she is currently posted at Gwaldam, District Chamoli, Uttarakhand.
Both petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 submit that they shall be moving the second motion later, in due course.
